name: Structure flip retest
idea: After a level breaks, wait for the market to come back to it from the other side and reject it: old resistance acting as support, or old support as resistance. A retest idea, never a breakout chase.

params.label: What broke
params.help: The kind of level whose retest is read.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the level the breaking close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: The range
params.help: For a range edge: the bars just before the break, or the consolidation found before it.
choice_labels: A set number of bars before the break

params.label: Range bars
params.help: For a range edge made of a set number of bars: how many bars before the break.

params.label: Volume expansion
params.help: For a range edge: the breaking bar's volume must be at least this many times the average (0 means no volume condition).

params.label: Line touches
params.help: For a trendline or a channel: how many swings must touch the line.

params.label: Retest within (bars)
params.help: The return must come within this many bars after the break; a later return is a new base, not a retest.

params.label: Buffer beyond the level
params.help: The idea is wrong when the market is back through the level by this many average true ranges (0 means the level itself).

setup.long: RetestEntry("up", $retest_of, $retest_max_bars, TRUE, k=$k, n=$range_n, v=$vol_mult, mode=$range_mode, touches=$touches)
setup.short: RetestEntry("down", $retest_of, $retest_max_bars, TRUE, k=$k, n=$range_n, v=$vol_mult, mode=$range_mode, touches=$touches)

invalidation.long: RetestEntryRef("stop_level_atr", "up", $retest_of, $retest_max_bars, TRUE, $stop_mult, k=$k, n=$range_n, v=$vol_mult, mode=$range_mode, touches=$touches)
invalidation.short: RetestEntryRef("stop_level_atr", "down", $retest_of, $retest_max_bars, TRUE, $stop_mult, k=$k, n=$range_n, v=$vol_mult, mode=$range_mode, touches=$touches)
